precepts.text: This is why it is saying, Flee out of the midst of the philosophies of Babylon the Great. It ain't necessarily talking about getting on a plane and going somewhere, because this whole earth is corrupted, but it means come out of the philosophies of how this system has got us thinking. That is the whole point: how we think. Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired. But the question is, gather yourselves together. Before the decree bring forth. In other words, that ye be not partakers of her plagues. It is saying the same thing in different words. Before the decree bring forth, before the destruction comes. Before the day pass as the chaff, before the destruction. Before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you. In other words, you have to do this so that you do not get caught in those things there.
precepts.point: Flee out of the midst of Babylon. This is the same thing that is said in Revelation. These three scriptures are saying the same thing.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
Zephaniah gives the order: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. This is why Jeremiah says, flee out of the midst of Babylon: flee out of the midst of the philosophies of Babylon the Great. It is not necessarily talking about getting on a plane and going somewhere, because this whole earth is corrupted. It means come out of the philosophies of how this system has got us thinking. That is the whole point: how we think.

“Before the decree bring forth”. In other words, that ye receive not of her plagues, as Revelation says. It is saying the same thing in different words. Before the decree bring forth means before the destruction comes. “before the day pass as the chaff”: before the destruction. “before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”. You have to do this so that you do not get caught in those things.

That is the “be not cut off in her iniquity” of Jeremiah 51:6: be not cut off, be not destroyed when the chaff goes through. “for this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance”, and we are in that time now. He is slapping the heads of these leaders, making them look stupid and crazy, in our presence.

And how do we return? Obey his commandments and organise, as the scriptures say. Become that mature nation in exponential growth; learn how to be an organised nation among ourselves, so that when we get the kingdom we will know how to act and how to operate as a nation. We are in the training ground. We were brought into captivity to learn a lesson, because we did not want to serve our Lord; when we learn it well, we come off our punishment and enjoy the kingdom.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired; before the decree bring forth, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you. Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger. If you are seeking righteousness, you are admitting you do not yet have it; you are walking in error and correcting it. So when you come to the house of learning and somebody shows you your error, do not leave mad; leaving means going back out to face the fierce anger unprepared.
precepts.point: News discussed in class: the hands of the civil rights era are being turned back right now. Memphis, one of the blackest cities in America, has been carved up by gerrymandering and parceled out to the outskirts of the state so that its people cannot win a congressional seat any more; it is happening in Texas and everywhere. An elected black congressman was hauled out by state troopers protesting that he was lawfully there. We frame the law by mischief is written for a reason. Our people swear they are going to vote their way out of this, and the churches that once organized the community are silent. Where is the Christian church on the front line while all of this is turned back, while our people are found hanged in 2026 and it is ruled suicide? The only ones crying aloud about it are the Israelites. The teaching stands: our people need to see the affliction for what it is, get their minds right, and get lined up on the right side before the decree brings forth.

note.label: Listen, Learn & Live The Art of Enduring in The Truth

precepts.why:
Our people will cry earnestly when death is before their eyes, and Zephaniah says what to do before it comes: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired; Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.”

“Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” If you are seeking righteousness, you are admitting that you don't have it yet; you are walking in error and correcting it. So pray, Lord, show me where I am in error so I can fix it, so that when your decree brings forth I am lined up on the right side. That means when somebody is sent to tell you, this is wrong, you hear it and learn, because you don't want to be on the outside of what is about to happen.

So when you come to the house of learning and somebody shows you your error, don't get mad and leave. Leaving means going back out there to face the fierce anger of God unprepared. While you are here, you are going to learn how to turn away from your sins.

As we see these afflictions happening, we know the judgment and the fierce anger of the Lord are coming. Our people are clueless about what is about to happen to them; in America we are so comfortable that hard living means cancelling Netflix. It is our job to warn them, and they have to be willing to listen and be gathered before the decree brings forth.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired: we're the nation not desired. Nobody want to be with us; no nation wants to take us in. So in our gathering together amongst ourselves, the law says be kindly affectioned one towards another.
precepts.point: Therefore, brethren, stand fast: stand firm in his truth. And hold the traditions which ye have been taught: hold the traditions of God's laws as you've been taught, whether by word, face to face, or our epistles.

note.label: Drowning in Sin & Perdition

precepts.why:
“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” We are the nation not desired. Nobody wants to be with us; no nation wants to take us in.

So we gather together amongst ourselves, and in that gathering the law says be kindly affectioned one towards another with brotherly love. The other nations hate to see it, but God told the nation not desired to gather itself together.

These are the brethren “beloved of the Lord” whom God “hath from the beginning chosen” to salvation. Others are given a strong delusion to believe a lie because they had pleasure in unrighteousness; the chosen are called by the gospel “to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.” So, brethren, stand fast, hold the traditions you have been taught, and gather together.

precepts.text: Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah. The residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them: own those nations.
precepts.point: For behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants. Write this down: the servants there is us. Right now we are their servants, but God will shake his hand upon the nations and they shall be a spoil to their servants.

note.label: Job Sees America's 250th Anniversary

precepts.why:
Zechariah 2:9 says “I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants”. Write this down: the servants there is us. Right now we are their servants. God will shake his hand upon the nations, and the nations shall be a spoil to their servants. The wording might be difficult for some of us, so here is a precept to explain it further.

“Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation”. See that: “the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.” Possess them means own those nations.

So when we go back to Zechariah, “they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.” The servants are Israel, the remnant of God's people. The nations that made us serve are going to be spoiled by us and possessed by us. America is described as Babylon, the land of the north, and the day is coming when the ones who served there will spoil it.

precepts.text: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border. You think they love us? God says they reproach us; they hate us. Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah: that has not happened yet. And the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them. Nobody escapes what they did to God's chosen people. And with that we say: twelve tribes.
precepts.point: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph. God says Moab is going to serve.

note.label: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

precepts.why:
God calls Moab his washpot, and Zephaniah shows why Moab and Ammon come to that end: “I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.”

God says, I heard what them damn Chinese said about my people, and the hatred of the Japanese. You think they love us? God says they reproach us; they hate us. They magnified themselves against the Israelites.

“Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation.” Destruction upon the earth: that is nuclear fire, and it has not happened yet.

“the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.” The remnant of God's people shall spoil them, put them into captivity, and possess them; they are going to serve us. Nobody escapes, brothers and sisters. Nobody gets away with what they did to God's chosen people. And with that we say: twelve tribes.

precepts.text: Three things beautiful before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, and a man and wife that agree together, on the commandments, not on the curtains.
precepts.point: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired: in the last days we gather with the believers who fear the Lord and make things common, because you cannot say to your brother be warmed and filled and go your way; true charity shows in adversity.

note.label: The God Of War & Salvation

precepts.why:
“In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.” The Lord puts the unity of brethren first. Then the love of neighbours: the charity, the long-suffering.

Then “a man and a wife that agree together.” Agree on what? The commandments. That is not talking about arguing over the curtains. Brother, when did you become a fashion designer, an interior decorator? Let your wife handle that. The agreement God counts beautiful is agreement in keeping his law.

This is what the gathering of Zephaniah 2:1 has to look like. “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”: the nation hated upon the earth has to come together in the last days. But as we gather, we have to fix our character flaws, show ourselves friendly, and endeavor to keep the unity, and endeavor is an enduring word, not one to be taken lightly.

Unity of brethren does not mean you cannot correct one another or admonish one another. It means you expect highly of each other. We need correction, admonishment, counsel and advice amongst each other. Those who push you toward hard things, who tell you the harsh truth when a lie would be easier, are your people. That is how the gathered nation stands up beautiful before God and men.

precepts.text: Thou shalt rebuke thy neighbour and not suffer sin upon him: a brother in sin may get the rough talk, and it is love to put him back in the righteous mindset.
precepts.point: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired: in the last days we gather with the believers who fear the Lord and make things common, because you cannot say to your brother be warmed and filled and go your way; true charity shows in adversity.

note.label: The God Of War & Salvation

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.” Love for one another means we are not supposed to suffer sin on one another.

So if I see my brother or my sister in the midst of sin, I might have to give them that rough talk. And it is to do what? To put them back in the righteous mindset. Real admonishment and love, being able to correct your brothers, comes with a little bit of hard criticism. You cannot take it emotionally, and you cannot take it personally. Tell the brother he is fat: fix it, brother. That is love, not hate.

Friends who roast each other are the loyal ones; those who value your success over the need to be liked are the ones who truly want your best. Their words are heavy, but their loyalty is pure. Don’t think that because a man is charitable he doesn’t correct anybody. We have to stop thinking with that emotional Christianity.

This is how the nation of Zephaniah 2:1 gathers. “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”: in the last days we gather with the believers who fear the Lord, and until we receive our homeland we are all we got. Rebuking one another in love keeps the gathered body clean and keeps the unity.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired, before the decree bring forth. They label us minorities, blacks, Hispanics, Dalits, Afro-Iranians, Afro-Palestinians, hated wherever we are scattered; Israelite unity is what they fear most. The decree is already made.
precepts.point: The ten horns shall hate the whore, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire: intercontinental ballistic missiles. Trump badmouths NATO over dues and threatens to end it, and now Europe does not want a long war. Before that comes, we must achieve abstinence, discipline, overcoming, and unity.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” Over time something will cause these kings to hate the whore, the United States of America. Trump badmouths NATO for not paying their fees and threatens to end the alliance, and now they don’t want to be drawn into a long war. They will make her desolate and naked with intercontinental ballistic missiles.

But before that comes, we have to achieve abstinence, discipline, overcoming, and unity. Zephaniah says: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. The nation not desired is us. They call us minorities and put labels on us, blacks, Hispanics, derogatory terms wherever we are: the Dalits in India, the Afro-Iranians, the Afro-Palestinians. Wherever we are scattered we are hated and despised. But the Bible says gather together. It is all about Israelite unity, and that is what they have always feared, because if the Israelites unify, that is the end of this wicked regime.

They even lie about Amalek. Bibi Netanyahu and his crew are the Amalekites according to the Bible, so to deflect that history they call the Iranians, the Persians, present-day Amalek.

“Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”. The decree is already made; it is prophesied, and destruction is coming. So take heed, acknowledge it, and get yourselves right.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together; seek the Lord, all ye meek of the earth; it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger.
precepts.point: Come to the school to get right. Sitting at home online shows love for Babylon.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
“Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.” We are literally the offspring of God, and idols are not him. “And the times of this ignorance God winked at”: he had mercy and was longsuffering with us, “but now commandeth all men every where to repent”, all Israelite men everywhere.

How do we answer that command? “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. The Bible tells the Israelites to gather together, not to be separate individuals. That is for all of you online who like to stay home and say, I don't like camps. Do what God said to do. Come in, learn, sit down and be quiet.

Some say, I want to come to the school, but I'm not right yet; I'll come when I get right. When is that going to be? You come to the school to get right; none of us are 100% right, we're all trying to get right. You aren't going to get right in your wicked mama's house or with your homeboys. Not gathering shows you love Babylon and white Jesus, that you're okay with black people shot down in the streets and on drugs, and it delays the coming of Christ.

Gather “Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”. Then: “Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment”, the curses of Deuteronomy 28; “seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” Joel says the same: “Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children”, and let the priests cry, “Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them”.

precepts.text: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast; the word of the Lord is against you, O Canaan.
precepts.point: The coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah, and the Lord will turn away their captivity.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
Remember what Isaiah 14 showed: the Palestinians are going to be destroyed out of that land, and so is Amalek. Zephaniah says it plainly: “Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”. The sea coast is Gaza. “the nation of the Cherethites” is the Palestinians. “the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.”

“And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks”, when those missiles hit. Then: “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.”

The house of Judah will live in Gaza. That is Judah's land, and Benjamin will be there too with the house of Judah. Give the Lord a hand for that.

That is why Jeremiah 47 goes on, “O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet?” The sword cannot be quiet, “seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” Gaza is the seashore. The judgment on the Philistines clears the coast for the remnant of Judah.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired, before the decree bring forth.
precepts.point: The nations shall bring Israel to its place and serve as servants and handmaids.

note.label: Jubilee: The Year To Be Set Free

precepts.why:
“For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land.” Before he sets us in our land, he tells the twelve tribes what to do: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” We are the nation not desired, and God is instructing the twelve tribes to gather themselves together, to wake up.

“Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.” That decree is the destruction that is prophesied to come. Get yourselves together before destruction comes. Things are moving at a quicker pace, and that is why the Bishop says he loves President Trump: he is forcing prophecies to come to pass and forcing the Israelites to do what the Bible says.

Who gathers? “Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” The meek are humble to God’s word, men and women who do his commandments without making excuses. We cannot gather with camps that say we are not keeping any Sabbath, or that throw you out for wearing fringes with a border of blue.

Then the judgment on the land: “For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation.” “I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.” The Palestinians are not just pushed out; according to the Bible they are destroyed. “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah”, “for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.” That is Israel set in their own land.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired; there is nowhere to obey that except gathered in a camp.
precepts.point: Separating yourself after receiving the knowledge of the truth is willful sin, and there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins, but a fearful looking for of judgment; that is doing despite unto the spirit of grace that woke us up in these last days.

note.label: Numbers 5: Put Out of the Camp, and the Law of Jealousies

precepts.why:
“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” Israel is the nation not desired, and the commandment is to gather. There is nowhere to obey that except gathered in a camp.

The Lord dwelt in the midst of the camp in the wilderness, and he is gathering his camp back together again to come and deliver us. If you are not in a camp, get in a camp.

precepts.text: For the reproach of Moab and the revilings of Ammon, Moab shall be as Sodom and Ammon as Gomorrah, the remnant of the Most High's people shall possess them, and men shall worship the Lord every one from his place.
precepts.point: The Lord will be terrible unto them and famish all the gods of the earth, and men shall worship Him every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen. That is why Balaam said he shall behold Him, but not nigh: the nations will worship from their own place and come up only at the appointed times of the year.

note.label: Numbers 24: A Star out of Jacob and the Latter Days

precepts.why:
Balaam saw the Sceptre out of Israel smite the corners of Moab, and Zephaniah gives the judgment. “I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.”

“Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation.” Moab shall be as Sodom and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, the breeding of nettles and salt pits; the stinging nettle is a plant that burns, and the fire that fell on Sodom is coming again.

“the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them. This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.” The residue of the Most High's people, the third that is left, shall spoil them, and the remnant shall possess them, for their pride against the people of the Lord of hosts.

“The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.” That is why Balaam said he shall behold Him, but not nigh: the nations will worship from their own place and come up only at the appointed times of the year.

precepts.text: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.
precepts.point: Their children which have not known any thing must hear and learn to fear the Most High. The first thing you establish with your children, before they know anything else, is who they are and who their God is.

note.label: Deuteronomy 31: Moses' Final Charge and the Rebellion Foretold

precepts.why:
Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi that bear the ark of the covenant, and to all the elders of Israel, with a command: “At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles”, when all Israel is come to appear before the Lord, “thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.” The law had to be taught over and over, to remind the people what would befall them and what they must do.

“Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the Lord your God, and observe to do all the words of this law”. Zephaniah gives the same call: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. Israel, the nation not desired, is to gather to hear and learn the law, the same gathering as at the feast of tabernacles.

“And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the Lord your God”. The first thing you establish with your children, before they know anything else, is who they are and who their God is.

precepts.text: The nation is called to gather itself together and seek the Most High before the day of his anger.
precepts.point: The prophets came together to accomplish a common mission. The work of the house does not get done unless the prophets and the people gather and labor together.

note.label: Ezra 5: The Prophets Rise Up To Build

precepts.why:
The house of God had been hindered for roughly two years when Haggai and Zechariah prophesied to the Jews, and Zerubbabel and Jeshua rose up to build, “and with them were the prophets of God helping them.” The prophets and the people came together for one common mission, and that is the call of Zephaniah: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.”

The gathering must happen “Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.” The nation is told to gather itself and “Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.”

The work of the house does not get done unless the prophets and the people gather and labor together, and the nation is to gather and seek the Most High before the day of his anger.

points: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired. We are not desired. O nation not desired.

Let me tell you a little bit about that nation that is not desired. This nation is desired only when we are in our ignorance. They love us. Listen to what I am saying. You black women, you cannot have enough babies in slavery. They breed us. Go lay with so-and-so. Get the stud. Get this one. Get that one. Lay with him. I want more bucks. I want more slaves. You could not stop having babies. You was having babies as young as twelve, eleven years old if they can get it. They wanted all kinds of babies from you so that they could put them in the field to work.
Where was Planned Parenthood then? Because the objective was for us to produce more labour for them, which is going on right now. Same damn thing. Sweat equity. That is what they want.

But now that we are waking up and we are coming back in tune with the real essence of us, and we want to organise among us — we ain't trying to harm nobody.
